title: Conda channel TLS verification disabled
description: .condarc declares an `ssl_verify` switch set to false. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `ssl_verify` switch set to false.
limitation: It matches an `ssl_verify` switch set to false in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
